Run an Empirical Micro-Pilot to Profile Runtime and Peak RSS Memory

Source: R/pilot.R
pilot_run.Rd

Executes a controlled sample slice of a workload (fun applied to selected elements of args_list) in isolated background child R processes while polling OS-level Resident Set Size (RSS) via ps. Separating cold worker startup overhead from marginal per-task execution time and measuring true process-tree RSS (including native C++/Stan/BLAS allocations) feeds directly into estimate_resources().

Usage

pilot_run(
  fun,
  args_list,
  n_pilot = NULL,
  sample_method = c("head", "stratified", "random"),
  cpus_per_task = 1L,
  sample_interval = 0.03,
  timeout_sec = 300,
  seed = NULL,
  packages = character(),
  globals = list(),
  isolate = TRUE,
  progress = FALSE,
  scrub_secrets = TRUE
)

Arguments

fun

A function accepting a single element of args_list (fun(arg)).

args_list

Non-empty list (or vector coercible to list) of per-task arguments.

n_pilot

Optional positive integer number of sample replications to profile. Defaults to min(length(args_list), 5L).

sample_method

Strategy for selecting pilot task indices from args_list: "head" (first n_pilot), "stratified" (evenly spaced across the workload), or "random".

cpus_per_task

Integer number of CPU threads exposed to each pilot trial (OMP_NUM_THREADS / OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS). Default 1L.

sample_interval

Numeric polling interval in seconds for OS RSS sampling of child processes. Default 0.03.

timeout_sec

Numeric per-trial timeout in seconds. Trials exceeding this limit are terminated and recorded as "TIMEOUT". Default 300.

seed

Optional integer base seed for reproducible sampling and child trial execution.

packages

Character vector of package names to attach inside each isolated worker before executing fun.

globals

Named list of helper objects or functions made available in fun's evaluation environment.

isolate

Logical; if TRUE (default), runs each trial in a fresh background R process via callr::r_bg() to measure true startup cost and isolated OS RSS. Set FALSE only for fast in-process profiling.

progress

Logical; if TRUE, emits concise progress messages via cli. Default FALSE.

scrub_secrets

Logical; when isolate = TRUE, scrub ambient host secret/credential environment variables before spawning pilot child processes. Default TRUE.

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_pilot" with elements:

  • trials: a tibble::tibble() with one row per pilot trial containing trial_id, task_index, status, wall_sec, startup_sec, exec_sec, baseline_rss_mb, peak_rss_mb, net_rss_mb, cpu_user_sec, cpu_sys_sec, n_samples, result_size_bytes, and error.

  • summary: named list of empirical quantiles and memory statistics.

  • meta: provenance metadata (n_pilot, n_total_hint, cpus_per_task, packages, sample_method, isolate, timestamp, r_version, platform, seed).

See also

estimate_resources(), slurm_autopilot()

Examples

args <- lapply(1:20, function(i) list(n = 200, seed = i))
pilot <- pilot_run(
  fun = function(x) {
    set.seed(x$seed)
    mean(rnorm(x$n))
  },
  args_list = args,
  n_pilot = 2L
)
print(pilot)
#> 
#> ── slurmpilot Micro-Pilot Profile 
#> • Trials: 2/2 succeeded (isolated=TRUE, cpus=1)
#> • Task exec time: median 0.000s, p90 0.000s, max 0.000s
#> • Worker startup: median 0.722s
#> • Memory (RSS): baseline 96.4 MB, peak max 96.9 MB, net max 0.5 MB
